P.desc: Nano multi-layer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. Designed for light roughing to finishing operations, both for wet and dry machining. Good choice for complex tool paths and sticky materials.

Hard, thin coated PVD-grade with Zertivo® technology for various applications. Suitable from light roughing to finishing in average stability for wet and dry machining. Good choice for complex tool paths and sticky ma…
Medium hard CVD-coated grade (medium to thick coating) designed for medium to rough milling applications in average cutting conditions for wet and dry machining.
Tough CVD-coated grade (medium thick coating) suited for tough and demanding medium to rough milling applications for wet and dry machining.
Hard, CVD-coated (thick coating) grade suitable for high cutting speeds in medium to rough milling application with good stability for dry machining.
Very hard PVD-coated with thin coating for finishing in very stable conditions and hardened materials for wet and dry machining.
Medium-hard, uncoated cermet grade for finishing applications at high cutting speeds for dry machining.
Medium hard PVD-coated grade with thin coating for sticky materials for wet and dry machining.
Tough CVD-coated grade (medium thick coating) for roughing in tough and demanding applications for wet and dry machining and good for mix material production.
Medium hard CVD-coated (thick coating) grade which complements GC4230 in abrasive materials.
Tough CVD-coated (thin coated) grade for turbine blade machining under tough and demanding conditions at high cutting speeds for wet and dry machining.
Hard PVD-coated grade (thin coating) for light roughing to finishing in sticky materials for wet and dry machining.

M.desc: Nano multi-layer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. Designed for light roughing to finishing operations, for both wet and dry machining. First choice for stainless steel in varying process conditions.

Tough, medium-thick coated CVD grade designed for tough and demanding, medium to rough milling applications with poor stability in dry conditions. High feed rates, large diameters and radial engagements.
Medium hard, thin-coated PVD grade to be used as a complement to GC1040 when stability is good and for demands on high cutting speed in wet and dry conditions.
Medium-hard, thin coated PVD grade for light roughing to finishing. Complement to GC1040 in good stability, for high cutting speeds in dry conditions.
Tough, thin-coated PVD grade for finishing to roughing in unstable to stable, wet or dry conditions. Good choice for complex tool paths and sticky materials.
Very tough, medium-thick-coated CVD grade designed for toughness-demanding medium to rough milling applications with poor stability. Can be used in both dry and wet conditions.

Nano multi-layer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. Designed for light roughing to finishing operations, for both wet and dry machining. Good choice for complex tool paths and sticky materials.
Medium-hard, uncoated cermet grade for finishing applications at high cutting speeds in dry conditions.
Very hard, thin-coated PVD grade for finishing in stable conditions for wet and dry machining.
Medium hard, medium-thick-coated CVD grade for medium to rough milling of martensitic stainless steels at elevated cutting speeds in average and dry conditions.
Tough, medium-thick-coated CVD grade for tough and demanding, medium to rough milling applications of martensitic stainless steels in dry conditions.

K.desc: Hard, CVD-coated grade with thick coating, designed for medium to rough milling of all cast iron in average to stable conditions, both dry and wet. First choice for gray cast iron and mixed ISO K applications. First c…
Hard, PVD-coated grade with thin coating for light to rough finishing of nodular cast iron in dry and wet conditions and gray cast iron in wet and average to stable conditions.
Hard, CVD-coated grade with very thick coating designed for high cutting speeds in medium to rough gray cast milling applications with good stability in dry conditions.
Medium-hard CVD grade with thick coating for tough and demanding medium to rough milling applications of gray cast iron in dry conditions.
Hard, CVD-coated grade with thin coating for finishing to light rough milling of all cast iron in stable and wet conditions. Ideal for large diameter cutters.
Hard, CVD-coated grade with very thick coating designed for high cutting speed in medium to rough gray cast iron milling applications with good stability in dry conditions.
Hard, CBN-tipped grade for light roughing to finishing of gray cast iron in stable, dry conditions. Use when dimensional stability and long tool life are crucial.
Very hard, PVD-coated grade with thin coating for finishing in very stable conditions. A harder complement to GC1020 in wet conditions.
Hard, uncoated carbide grade for rough to finish milling with sharp cutting edges, at low speeds and in average to stable, dry and wet conditions.
Tough, CVD-coated grade with medium-thick coating, for use as a tougher complement to GC3040 when stability is poor, in dry and wet conditions.
Medium-hard, CVD-coated grade with medium-thick coating, for toughness-demanding, medium to rough milling applications of nodular cast iron in dry and wet conditions.
Hard, CVD-coated grade with medium-thick coating, for medium to rough milling in various applications of all kinds of cast iron, mainly dry conditions.

Hard, CVD-coated grade with thin coating for finishing of cast iron and bi-metal components, such as cast iron and aluminum, in stable and wet conditions. Use as a complement to K20W when a sharp edge is needed.

H.desc: Hard nano-multilayer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. First choice for light roughing to finishing of pre-hardened steels of 36 HRC or higher, in dry and very stable conditions.
Hard CVD grade with a thick coating for light roughing to finishing at low feeds, moderate speeds and large radial engagements in the lower ISO H hardness range for both wet and dry machining.

Nano multi-layer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. Designed for light roughing to finishing at low feeds, moderate speeds and small radial engagements in the lower ISO H hardness range for both wet a…
Medium-hard uncoated cermet grade for light finishing in stable and dry conditions.
Hard CBN-tipped grade for semi-finishing to finishing in very stable and dry conditions. Use when dimensional stability and long tool life are crucial.
Medium-hard, thick coated CVD grade that can be used as a backup to GC4220 in unstable and dry conditions.

N.desc: Hard, uncoated grade for roughing to semi-finishing with sharp edges in average to stable conditions. Excellent surface finish in wet and dry machining.
Very hard, uncoated grade for light roughing to finishing with sharp cutting edges in stable conditions with high demands on the quality of the surface finish for wet and dry machining.

Polycrystalline diamond-tipped grade (PCD) with sharp edges for light roughing to finishing in stable conditions for wet or dry machining with a high demand on the quality of the surface finish and process stability. …
Medium-hard, uncoated cermet grade for finishing in rather stable conditions and elevated cutting speeds in wet and dry conditions.
Hard, thin-coated PVD Zertivo™ grade for roughing to semi-finishing in average conditions with less demands on surface finish in wet and dry conditions.
Hard, uncoated grade for light roughing to finishing with sharp edges in average conditions for good surface in wet and dry conditions.

S.desc: A medium-hard nano-multilayer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology and EthaCore™ substrate. First choice for roughing to semi-finishing of titanium alloys. Also suitable for heat-resistant super alloys a…
A very tough, medium-thick-coated CVD grade for roughing in toughness-demanding applications. Can be used in both wet and dry conditions.
Nano multi-layer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo®
Hard nano-multilayer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. For finishing in very stable conditions.
Nano multi-layer PVD-coated grade produced with Zertivo® technology. A more wear-resistant grade option to GC1250 for optimized tool life.
Medium-hard, thin-coated PVD grade to be used as a complement to S30T for long time in cut. Can be used in both wet and dry conditions.
Tough, medium-thick coated CVD grade for roughing in toughness-demanding applications. Use as a complement to S40T for large diameters or large radial engagements in wet and dry conditions.
Hard, uncoated grade for light roughing to finishing in stable conditions with high demands on sharp edges and surface finish for both wet and dry conditions.
Hard uncoated grade for use as backup for H10F in more stable applications. Can be used in both wet and dry conditions.
